notes.zh: 换手机不用重买：打开「关于 → 售后支持 → 换机找回」，填下单时用的邮箱，伙伴就自己走回来。同一单可以在手机、Windows、Mac 各点亮一台。
notes.en: New phone? No need to buy again. Open About - Support - Move to a new device, enter the email you ordered with, and your buddies walk back by themselves. One order lights up one device on Android, Windows and Mac.
